name: licensing-review
description: Produce the structured JSON decision for a State licensing review task by reading records from the shared licensing HTTP environment. Covers three task families served by the same environment: (1) contractor batch eligibility reviews, (2) restricted liquor-license staff packages, and (3) alcohol renewal manual-review queues. Use whenever a prompt asks for a JSON answer conforming to input/payloads/answer_template.json against endpoints like /api/policies, /api/contractor/*, /api/liquor/*, /api/alcohol/*, /api/renewal/rules, or POST /api/sql.
